comments.value: Unfriending because of poor avatar?!? Sorry I don't know who you hang out with but that is sad. People don't instablock poor avatars, they just hide them...

details:
I read a lot of comments on neighboor cannyies, discord talks, and in-game swearing. I noticed that ppl are concerned more about that fact that ppl can now knew your avatar metrics, rather that fact metrics got counted or represented incorrectly. An this concerns me.

I am 100% for publicy showing avatar metrics. And now I'll try to explain why:

Ppl say: "This punish players with new hard-to-make limits."
No, it's no. Where is limits? You are free to choose: will your avatar be simple as cube and run quickly or will your avatar have a lot of spec-effect that makes your avatar unique, beautiful and attractive? No body says that "poor" is "bad". You are free to have laggy avatar. Legally. Fantestic.

Ppl say: "This causes misunderstanding: ppl see "poor" and insta-block poors".
I don't think it's true. A lot of ppl have "poor". Seems it's more "poors" than "goods" and "mediums" together. Do ppl rly block half of VRC players? I can't belive into that. Bad represenatation is a problem for now. But if someone so stupid and instablock every "poor" w/o even talking to players and w/o even checking detailed stats, then... It's they own choise. Respect their right to be stupid... <>(9)<> 

Ppl say: "This causes discrimination..."
Where? Did your friends unfriend you when they figured out that you have a lot dynbone colliders and materials? Or maybe because you only one in socgroup having "green star"? Yes? Then think carefully: are these ppl REALLY was your friends? Did you get blocked by other players? So, opinion of random strangers have a huge weight for you? Is it rly bothers you, when you get blocked? And why you not respect others opinion and right to block avatars? Maybe that dude had potato PC, and there is nothing personal? Or you got bullied? Lol don't communicate with trolls then. Block them. I see nothing wrong with ppl blocking each other. Well, it's not cool that ppl with different opinions don't want to hear each other, but if you want to play in specific comfort social environment, why not to form that?

Ppl say: "...same as Player Ranking (Trust) System".
Wait a sec, is it rly exists? For a months from begining of beta test of that system, I NEVER meet REAL descrimination against some of player ranks. I never saw someone block ppl for being blocked/buiilied or being veteran or newbie. There is was some trolling and satire at begining, but mostly about whole drama in general.

Ppl say: "It's not objective same as Player Ranking (Trust) System".
Actually Performance Ranking System at least trying to be objective. And can be 100% accurate with some extra (real time?) deeper inspections and adjustments. Compaing to Trust it's lies much less. It's already exists few ways to bypass some counting on some metrics, but if it will be fixed, then it will be mostly correct. If it's says you have 1k dynbone collision checks it's true: you have 1k dynbone collision checks. That raw fact. Not guess of "User Ranking AI (tm)" You a free to interpret this as you want... ...comparing to Trust, where you have that given trust levels, we'll not explain you why that player have that rank and other have other, but remember: you should trust this "trusted user" - he should not do anything to you (no, you should not trusted: he'll crash you), and should not trust this "visitor" - he can abuse you with shitty content (no, you should trust: he is a nice dude and uses moderated avatar from a world). Comapring to useless Trust you can read metrics of Performance as you want and make own judge. This is much much better and I actually would like to have avatar blocking based on Performance rather than on Trust.

And another one for publicity is responsibility: all want to have huge FPS but no one wants to optimize. We hiding progress on optimization. And see only FPS we got from all together, w/o knowlege about each other contribution into that. So we got communism here. Performance System smell like bizzare 1991. Now we can know the price for things. Now we can know who is who. Who works well on avatars and who is FPS-stealers. Not by icon over nameplate, but by detailed stat reading. And everyone can do anything with that info. Can hate and block ppl. Can continue to have fun. Now we can not be shy of being "poor", because almost everyone is "poor". Now we can be motivate to do optimizations. Great.
title: A few words to protecc stats publicity of Avatar Performance Ranking System. (This is mostly for community, than for devs.)
